title: ResolvedOutcome
description: The PUBLIC/narrator-facing projection of a committed outcome (v1.4, movement-blocked note): everquill_engine.views.outcome_public applied to the canonical resolver contract. The canonical event still records exact hp and internal-only flags server-side; this view NEVER carries them. hp changes appear only as wound_transition deltas (fiction effect words, never numbers -- exact hp is true-sheet data); flag deltas survive only for the public allowlist prefixes (owes_favor_/rebuffed_/noticed_by_/discovered_/scar_/marked_), internal flags are stripped. Everything here is already committed to the append-only event log (event_id) before the narrator sees it -- narration can never change it. Dice and modifiers are post-roll Chronicle data (auditable, KNOWN-safe band-derived labels only). Current resolver contracts also carry optional backward-compatible system_note and movement_blocked fields for deterministic API routing of blocked movement. additionalProperties is false at every level.

event_id.description: Local bigint id (string form) of the committed event this outcome derives from -- internal correlation only. Narration binds to the record, never the other way round.

event_ulid.description: THE stable external id of the committed outcome event (MEDIUM-6, v1.2): use this for client references, narration binding, and logical copy/merge. Null only when served from a legacy read that did not select the column.

tier_resolved.description: The plausibility-ladder tier the ENGINE resolved this action at (roadmap 3.1). Never influenced by the parser's plausibility_hint beyond routing.

risk_label_shown.description: The engine-calculated risk label that was shown to the player PRE-roll, in words never percentages (roadmap 3.1). Null when no roll occurred (trivial, impossible, sealed-with-unmet-components).

outcome_tier.description: 2d6 three-tier result. Null when no roll occurred (trivial narrate-only; impossible -- fiction reacts to the attempt itself). Hopeless is failure-flavor only: outcome_tier is always miss and the dice picked HOW you fail. Sealed with unmet components fails forward as miss without dice.

dice.description: Post-roll Chronicle data: the honest 2d6, the KNOWN-safe modifier breakdown, and the total. Shown to the player in full after resolution -- every death must be auditable without trusting prose. Null when no roll occurred.

state_deltas.description: Typed state changes committed by this outcome. Every miss writes something (intel, rumor seed, scar, journal line) -- an empty array is legal only for pure narrate-only beats.

narration_constraints.description: Hard constraints the narrator prompt must enforce for this outcome. Closed vocabulary; registry with rationale in docs/contracts/README.md. Extending it is a contract change, not a prompt tweak.

system_note.description: Engine-authored System line committed with trivial no-op outcomes. Used by the API for deterministic movement-blocked responses; null when no System line is needed. Optional for historical fixture compatibility; current resolver writes it on every outcome.

movement_blocked.description: True only when a declared movement action could not resolve to a direct authored exit and the engine supplied the exit-list system_note. Optional for historical fixture compatibility; current resolver writes false on non-blocked outcomes.

rolls.description: The two d6 faces, in roll order.

modifiers.description: KNOWN-safe modifier breakdown. Labels come from the player's known sheet vocabulary (named abilities, visible conditions, declared approach) and MUST NOT leak true-sheet values or names the player has not earned.

total.description: rolls sum plus modifier sum. The engine guarantees arithmetic; validators should re-check it (schema cannot).

delta_wound_transition.description: Public redaction of an hp change (EQ-R2-03). Carries a FICTION effect only -- the exact hp amount and cause are true-sheet data and live solely in the canonical server-side event. `dispatched` when the change drops the target to 0 (resulting wound word), otherwise `wounded`/`recovered` by the sign of the change.

amount.description: In base coin units (copper); negative = spent/lost.

delta_flag.description: Public flag delta (EQ-R2-03 + Slice 3 danger marks): only allowlisted social/discovery/mark prefixes reach this view -- internal flags (journal_hook_/humbled_/botched_/attempted_/rapport_/...) are stripped by views.outcome_public before validation.

transit_hint.description: HOW the entity moved -- the resolver sets it where derivable (declared travel = walked); events written before v1.2 render as unknown.

claim_write.description: A claim written to the player's Codex at outcome time (claim_id assigned on commit; corroboration/contradiction links computed by projection, not written here). Failed research legally writes wrong intel at high confidence -- the schema carries provenance, never truth. v1.2 (claim schema v2, HIGH-5): typed predicate from the CLOSED vocabulary (everquill_engine.claims.PREDICATES -- the code registry is the source of truth; llm/ validates via claims.enforce_predicate) + typed value columns replace the free-text value_or_range; acquisition_method is the closed evidence-weight vocabulary. Events written before v1.2 are upcast on read. Kept deliberately looser in narration_context.schema.json#/$defs/claim (read-time shape still serves value_or_range for compatibility -- see README changelog).

predicate.description: Closed controlled vocabulary (module registry everquill_engine.claims.PREDICATES; append-only). Contradiction stays SQL equality on (believer, subject, predicate) -- never NLI/LLM checking.

value_num.description: Integer-only (LOW-1): folded numeric domains never carry floats.

world_valid.description: World-minute validity range of the FACT (whereabouts-class predicates only).

layer.description: chronicle = authoritative fact of record; inquiry = fallible dossier claim.

source.description: Named source (a person, ballad, ledger, appraisal).

method.description: Site-specific acquisition detail (witnessed, appraisal_ii, archive_research, rumor, inherited_journal, ...).

acquisition_method.description: Closed evidence-weight vocabulary; base weights observed > told > rumor > inherited_journal > overheard.

source_agent_id.description: Who told them (null for direct observation).

scope.description: Where/what the claim covers (local-vs-universal is a canonical wrong-intel mechanism).

confidence.description: Evidence consistency, NEVER truth-probability. Display value since v1.2 -- ranking strength lives in the claim projection (decayed evidence-weight sum).

description.description: Factual record for rumor propagation -- concrete facts, never generated praise.

deed_ref.description: Event ID of the witnessed deed that minted it, null only for chargen-origin titles.

advance.description: World-time units advanced. Unit definition belongs to Team A's world-clock spec (PROVISIONAL).

delta_death_record.description: The sealed death record, committed BEFORE narration (heir flow phase 1). Death narration binds to exactly these facts: no invented witnesses, sacrifices, or final words.

cause.description: Mechanical cause, auditable from the Chronicle.

delta_reputation.description: Reputation delta (Sprint 4, The Self & The Social): the actor's own standing moved. scope=disposition (subject=NPC id) | standing (subject=settlement id) | renown (subject='' global). amount is the signed change, already clamped by the resolver to the design band; the fold applies it verbatim. Public and un-redacted -- it is the player's EARNED standing, so the narrator may bind warming/cooling to it and the Self view reflects it (KNOWN-safe, like a named modifier).

subject_id.description: NPC id (disposition), settlement id (standing), or '' (global renown).

amount.description: Signed change; resolver-clamped so the running total stays in band.
